info.headline: Moderate Flood Warning for Warrego River downstream of Charleville, Warrego River at Cunnamulla Bridge and Warrego River at Rocky
info.description:
Moderate flooding is likely along the lower Warrego River between Cunnamulla Bridge and Rocky.
No current river level observations are available for the Warrego River at Cunnamulla Bridge. However, based on river levels at the nearby automatic gauge, the river level at Cunnamulla Bridge is estimated to have peaked at around the moderate flood level during Tuesday and to be easing slowly just below the moderate flood level, with minor flooding. The Warrego River at Cunnamulla Bridge is likely to remain above the minor flood level (6.00 m) for the remainder of the week.
No current river level observations are available for the Warrego River at Rocky. The river level is estimated to be near the moderate flood level and rising slowly. The Warrego River at Rocky is likely to peak around the moderate flood level (4.00 m) from Wednesday afternoon.
info.instruction:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous. * Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways. * Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads. * Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay informed. * For local emergency management warnings and advice visit www.disaster.qld.gov.au/warnings.
For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.
